ogTitle: Marysville Tile That Outlasts the Receipt
ogDesc: Bought your tile at a big-box store? Good. We build what belongs under it — membrane, flood test, photos — so a $3 tile lasts like a $30 one. From $14/sq ft installed. (425) 595-1079.

roles.heroLead: A $3 clearance tile and a $30 designer tile fail the exact same way in a Marysville shower — through the layer behind them, because tile and grout don't stop water and never did. The membrane does. We build that assembly, flood it for 24 hours, photograph the proof, and only then start setting.
roles.costH2: How much does tile installation cost in Marysville, WA?
roles.costP1: In Marysville, installed tile lands around $14–$26 per square foot once tile, setting materials, substrate prep and labor are totaled — labor starts at $11/sq ft on its own. Standard tub-shower surrounds run $3,200–$6,800, a full bathroom with floor, shower and niche usually finishes between $6,500 and $14,000, and a bathroom floor alone (roughly 45 sq ft) prices at $900–$1,600.
roles.costP2: The number that catches value shoppers off guard: labor follows the tile's format, not its price. Mosaic sheets at $4 can cost more to set than $12 large-format porcelain planks, because installers charge for cuts and grout lines, not for your receipt.
roles.costNote: Ranges for Marysville homes as of August 2026, covering tile, materials and labor. The real number is the written one from your free estimate.
roles.layersLead: Seven layers, working up from the subfloor. Every failed shower we've opened skipped one — almost always the membrane, traded away for a few hundred dollars of savings on a job that later costs five figures to tear back open.
roles.whyP1: Nothing announces a shower leak. Water gets past grout, saturates the substrate, and turns up two years later as a soft spot in the hall floor or a bloom on the ceiling underneath. By that stage the fix involves framing, subfloor, drywall and starting the tile over.
roles.whyP2: Call waterproofing 10% of a shower's price. Deleting it to trim a bid is the most expensive line anyone ever cuts from a bathroom remodel.
roles.scopeIntro: Starting prices below — tile format, the condition of your substrate and layout complexity all move them. On-site quotes are written and free.
roles.cardShower: Complete waterproofed build — pre-slope, bonded membrane, flood test, then niche, curb or curbless entry and the tile itself. The invisible part is the part worth paying for.
roles.cardFloors: Bathrooms, kitchens, mudrooms, entries and basements. Subfloor gets flattened first, with an uncoupling membrane wherever movement or radiant heat asks for one.
roles.cardBacksplash: Mosaic sheet, subway, herringbone or slab-look porcelain — outlet cuts and edge trim done clean, grout matched to your counter instead of the tile box.
roles.cardHeated: Electric radiant mat over an uncoupling membrane, resistance-tested twice — before and after setting — on a dedicated circuit. Worthwhile only while the floor's open.
roles.cardRepair: Cracked tiles, failing grout, loose corners in the shower. We'll be straight about whether a repair will hold or the substrate underneath is already done.
roles.cardDemo: Thinset, backer and old tile out, dust held back with sheeting and negative air, all of it hauled off. Nothing piles up in your driveway.
roles.materialsLead: Big-box tile is fine — we set it all the time in Marysville. What matters is matching tile to room, and that's where most regret starts. Here's the version we'd tell you in the aisle.
roles.materialsNote: Prices are for material only, install not included. We bring samples and say plainly which ones justify their cost.
roles.estIntro: Scope, footage, tile format, prep — the same math we'd run standing in your kitchen. It isn't a quote, but it's honest enough to build a budget on.
roles.daysLead: Budget four to six working days for a standard Marysville bathroom. The two unglamorous days in the middle are exactly why it holds up.
roles.reviewsH2: What homeowners around the Sound say
roles.faqQ1: How much does tile installation cost in Marysville, WA?
roles.faqA1: Around $14 to $26 per square foot installed is the Marysville range, adding up tile, setting materials, substrate prep and labor; labor on its own starts at $11 per square foot. Tub-shower surrounds typically run $3,200 to $6,800, and a complete bathroom — floor, shower, niche — usually totals $6,500 to $14,000. What you pay tracks the tile's format more than its price: mosaics and large-format both demand far more labor per square foot than a basic 12×12.
roles.faqQ2: How much does it cost to tile a shower in Marysville?
roles.faqA2: A standard alcove shower in Marysville prices at $3,200 to $6,800 — that covers demolition, the bonded waterproofing system, a pre-sloped base or pan, tile setting, a niche and grout. Steam showers, benches, curbless entries and full-height stone go higher. The waterproofing itself is about a tenth of the bill, and it's what stands between you and a repair costing tens of thousands.
roles.faqQ3: Do you waterproof showers before tiling?
roles.faqA3: Yes, every time. A bonded waterproofing system goes behind our tile — never just cement board topped with thinset. Pre-sloped base, membrane run up the walls, corners, seams and pipe penetrations sealed, then a documented 24-hour flood test, photographed, before the first tile is set. Tile and grout let water through; the membrane is the only thing keeping it out of the framing.
roles.faqQ4: How long does a bathroom tile job take?
roles.faqA4: Count on four to six working days for a Marysville bathroom: demolition and dust protection, substrate and waterproofing plus the 24-hour flood test, one to two days setting tile, then grout, silicone and trim on the last day. Add 24 hours for grout to cure before anyone showers. A standalone floor usually wraps in one to two days.
roles.faqQ5: Porcelain or ceramic tile — which is better?
roles.faqA5: Porcelain, for anything wet or walked on — it's denser, absorbs under 0.5% water and resists chips, which is why it belongs on floors and in showers. Ceramic saves money and works well on walls and backsplashes. Our rule in Marysville homes: porcelain underfoot and on shower floors, ceramic or glass where it only has to look good.
roles.faqQ6: Can you install a heated tile floor?
roles.faqA6: Yes — and per dollar it's the best comfort upgrade in the house. Electric radiant mat under tile runs about $11 to $16 per square foot installed with the thermostat, and it only makes sense while the floor is already torn up. Ours goes over an uncoupling membrane, gets resistance-tested before the tile goes down and again after, and takes its own dedicated circuit.
roles.faqQ7: Do I need to remove the old tile first?
roles.faqA7: Almost always. Tear-out and haul-away run about $3.50 per square foot, and it's the only chance to see the subfloor — checking for rot and movement — and to keep the new floor from sitting too tall at doorways. Tiling over old tile is possible when the existing floor is flat, solid and well bonded, but it hides exactly the problems demolition would have exposed.
roles.faqQ8: How much does a kitchen backsplash cost in Marysville?
roles.faqA8: A typical 30 square foot kitchen backsplash in Marysville installs for $1,100 to $2,200, including outlet cuts, edge trim and grout matched to your counters. The high end of that range is layout time, not fancier material — mosaic sheets, herringbone, framed details behind the range and slab-look porcelain all take longer to cut and set.
roles.faqQ9: Can you fix cracked tile or regrout instead of replacing?
roles.faqA9: Often — and it's real money saved. Repair and regrout start at $8 per square foot: the answer for stained or crumbling grout, a couple of impact-cracked tiles, or shower corners that need grout replaced with silicone. If tiles ring hollow, pop loose in a spreading pattern, or the wall flexes, the substrate is gone and a repair only postpones the invoice. We diagnose before we price.
roles.faqQ10: Which Marysville neighborhoods do you tile?
roles.faqA10: Everywhere in Marysville — Downtown, Sunnyside, Getchell Hill, Pinewood, Shoultes, Kellogg Marsh, Marshall, Cedarcrest, Whiskey Ridge, Soper Hill, Jennings Park, Lakewood and Smokey Point — plus Tulalip, Priest Point, Arlington, Lake Stevens, Everett and the rest of north Snohomish County.
roles.faqQ11: What warranty comes with tile installation?
roles.faqA11: OC Flooring backs tile installation with a 2-year workmanship warranty — double what we offer on carpet, since tile trouble shows in year two rather than week two. Install a manufacturer's full bonded waterproofing assembly and their warranty stacks on top of ours, and because we photograph the membrane and flood test, the proof exists for as long as you own the house.
roles.hoodsOut: Don't spot your neighborhood? We work anywhere within about an hour of Marysville — mention it when you call.
